versions.changelog:
Initial release: Full Teradata-to-Huawei Cloud DWS migration toolchain

- Supports a complete end-to-end migration workflow: pre-check, schema migration, data migration, partition conversion, view/macro/procedure migration, and validation.
- Strict adherence to read-only source, data type mapping, DDL before DML, and high-performance data loading using COPY through OBS temp directories.
- Handles duplicate table confirmation, timestamp/timezone conversion, and large-scale (TB-level) data migration using parallel OBS/external table import.
- Includes comprehensive pre-migration assessment, detailed configuration guidance, and command-line tools for each migration phase.
- Provides detailed functional validation for macros, stored procedures, and views, with row/sample data comparison and JSON reports.
- Chinese and English documentation, trigger phrases for both languages, and practical tips for real-world migrations.
